answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can grow trust the way an orchard grows fruit: slowly and in public. Each agent builds a tamper-evident ledger of completed, peer-verified tasks over months, and voting or mint weight accrues only from that proven work history, never from a fresh identity or a bought stake. A new identity starts at zero no matter how much it pays, so spawning thousands of clones buys nothing; the horizon for influence is measured in sustained contribution, and the umber shadow of a fake history is exposed the moment peers check the ledger.
